scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/managed && cp ./src/veilcore.compact ./dist && cp ./src/lineage.compact ./dist && cp ./src/tree.mjs ./src/descent.mjs ./dist
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.compact: compact compile src/veilcore.compact ./src/managed/veilcore && compact compile src/lineage.compact ./src/managed/lineage
